FULL TEXT:
REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 72 /R&A Dated: 11th September, 2026
In continuation to this Court’s Notice No. 12/R&A dated 10th March, 2026 whereby the final
result for appointment to the post of Regular Mazdoor under Advertisement No. PHC/01/2025 for
Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025 has been published, it is hereby notified that the
following 03 (three) candidates (details mentioned at Table-A) who had prayed for extension of joining
time, have been granted extension of joining time till 10.10.2026 for joining to the post of Regular
Mazdoor subject to furnishing of the original SLC/CLC of their educational qualification by them
at the time of joining:
Table-A
Sl. No. Roll Number Registration Number Name of the Candidate
01. 114763 223423 AROHI BHARTI
02. 134117 225789 RAHUL HANSDA
03. 143579 279290 KRISHNA KUMAR
The aforesaid candidates are informed to report for joining in the Recruitment & Appointment
Cell of this Court by 10.10.2026 with all required documents as mentioned in their appointment letters
including the original SLC/CLC of their educational qualification.
By order of the Court
Sd/- Rupesh Deo
Registrar General
